clue.text: Outside left in a fine score, tumbling

indicators.note: in tells us the left piece sits inside the pair formed by a and fine

parts.note: F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

indicators.note: tumbling means the letters of score fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A winger plays a lovely piece of football, then falls over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outside left' reads as a football winger's position, but 'Outside' alone is the definition and 'left' gives L; 'tumbling' rearranges the last word into RESCO.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something al fresco means doing it in the open air, outdoors.

clue.text: File a nail with end of file

parts.note: a brad is a thin small-headed nail

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of the word file

explanation.surface: A manicure instruction: smooth a nail with the tip of a file.
explanation.definitionFit: To file something is to wear it down by rubbing, exactly what abrading does.

clue.text: Hardly starves eating last of pie!

definitions.text: Hardly starves eating last of pie!

indicators.note: eating means the word for going without food takes in the next piece

parts.note: someone who starves goes without food, that is fasts

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of the word pie

explanation.surface: Someone tucking into the end of a pie is hardly starving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hardly' turns the wordplay into the definition: banquets are the opposite of starving, and E (last of pie) goes inside FASTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Lavish banquets are the very opposite of going without food, so they describe hardly starving.

indicators.note: holding means the run of letters sits inside the words Opponent erroneously

explanation.surface: A rival has, by mistake, got hold of a record.
explanation.definitionFit: To enter details is to record them, as in a register or ledger.

clue.text: Conservative leader heads more hopeful staff…

indicators.note: heads means the leader's letter goes at the top of the next piece
leader picks the opening letter of the word Conservative

parts.note: rosier means more optimistic, more hopeful

explanation.surface: A Tory party leader puts more optimistic people at the top of his team.
explanation.definitionFit: A crosier is the hooked staff carried by a bishop.

clue.text: Gabble on, sharing secrets in private, initially

definitions.text: Gabble on, sharing secrets in private, initially

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of each preceding word in the clue

explanation.surface: Chattering away, swapping confidences privately: a description of tittle-tattle.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle chatter that trades secrets is exactly what tittle-tattle means, and the whole clue describes it.

clue.text: …Tories we fancy getting hard, or else!

indicators.note: getting means the rearranged letters take in the next piece
fancy as an adjective suggests something elaborate, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A threat aimed at Conservatives: toughen up, or else!
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links back to the Conservative leader of 4 Down, but it is only surface; 'fancy' gives OTERWISE and 'getting' takes in H, the pencil grade.
explanation.definitionFit: Otherwise and or else are synonyms meaning in other circumstances, often used as a threat.

definitions.meaning: a remedy targeted at one particular disease, an old medical noun

explanation.definitionFit: A specific is a medicine for one ailment; as an adjective it means precise or fixed.

parts.note: a plea is an earnest appeal
sure means certain

explanation.surface: A request for confirmation that something will please.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleasure and satisfaction are near synonyms for the feeling of enjoyment.

clue.text: Response in care to new treatment

indicators.note: new treatment means the letters are given a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A patient's reaction to a new course of treatment in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: A reaction is a response to some stimulus.

clue.text: It's hard when things are tough!

definitions.text: It's hard when things are tough!

parts.words: It's hard when things are tough!
parts.note: a type of firm dairy food, and the British exclamation of sympathy 'hard ...!' said when luck is bad

explanation.surface: A rueful remark about hard times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hard cheese!' is a British expression meaning bad luck; cheese is also something hard.
explanation.definitionFit: The word completes the British phrase of mock sympathy for bad luck, and names a hard food.

definitions.meaning: the four compass points north, east, west and south, abbreviated

explanation.definitionFit: A news bulletin reports current events; the compass point initials spell the word too.

clue.text: Put off by the compiler's influence

parts.note: to deter is to put off or discourage
the setter speaking of himself: belonging to me, mine

explanation.surface: Discouraged by the setter's sway over things.
explanation.definitionFit: To determine an outcome is to influence or decide it.

indicators.note: around means the edges piece goes round the next piece

parts.note: rims are edges or boundaries

explanation.surface: Borders drawn round a European city.
explanation.definitionFit: Reims is a city in the Champagne region of France.

definitions.meaning: to shoulder a burden is to carry or ... it
to stomach something is to tolerate it

explanation.definitionFit: To bear means both to carry a load and to put up with something.

clue.text: Spare former husband with single payment

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse
one means single
a rate is a charge or payment

explanation.surface: Let off a former husband with a single lump-sum settlement.
explanation.definitionFit: To exonerate is to clear of blame, sparing someone punishment.

indicators.note: rigged means fixed or tampered with, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rigged price is even more scandalous.
explanation.definitionFit: Spicier gossip is racier, more scandalous.

clue.text: Run down by one man in Capri?

indicators.note: by means the numeral stands beside the next piece

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
to run someone down is to disparage or slander them

explanation.surface: A man on Capri knocked over by someone.
explanation.walkthrough: Capri is an island, so the question mark marks the definition as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Capri is an island, so a man living there is an example of an island dweller.

clue.text: Roundabout start with learner on roundabout

indicators.note: with means the learner's letter is added on

parts.note: ca, short for circa, means round about or approximately
to rouse is to start up, as game is started from cover
L is the learner plate abbreviation

explanation.surface: A learner driver starts out on a traffic roundabout.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts ROUSE and L beneath CA, the abbreviation of circa (about).
explanation.definitionFit: A carousel is a merry-go-round, called a roundabout in Britain.

definitions.meaning: to dog someone is to follow them closely
to tail someone is to follow them secretly

explanation.definitionFit: To shadow someone is to follow them, just as dogging and tailing do.

parts.note: the hip is a joint

explanation.surface: A second blow to the hip leads to a slap.
explanation.walkthrough: A smack is a small sailing boat, not a slap.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack is a type of fishing boat, hence a ship.

clue.text: Power cut producing expression of astonishment

parts.note: P is the physics abbreviation for power
to hew is to cut

explanation.surface: A power cut prompts a gasp of surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation people utter in relief or amazement.

indicators.note: carrying means the servant word holds the next piece inside

parts.note: a page is a young servant
OTT stands for over the top, too much

explanation.surface: A servant bringing an excessive helping of stew.
explanation.definitionFit: Pottage is a thick soup or stew.

indicators.note: in means the swearing word goes inside the emptied town
empty leaves only the first and last letters of town

parts.note: to aver is to swear or affirm

explanation.surface: Cursing in a deserted town's pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A tavern is an inn or pub.

indicators.note: consumed by means the abstainer letters go inside the next piece

parts.note: a thirst is a need, a craving
TT means teetotal, an abstainer from alcohol

explanation.surface: A teetotaller caught out by his own thirst.
explanation.definitionFit: Netted means caught, as in a net.

parts.note: ado is fuss or much trouble
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Lots of bother over love.
explanation.definitionFit: To adore someone is to love them deeply.

clue.text: Lacking a will of one's own…

definitions.text: Lacking a will of one's own…

parts.words: Lacking a will of one's own
parts.note: reads as being weak-willed, but means dying without having made a legal will

explanation.surface: A description of a spineless person.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who dies without a valid legal will is said to die in this state.

definitions.meaning: to move something away, displace it
a simple straight dress or chemise

explanation.definitionFit: To shift is to move something, and a shift is a loose straight dress.

indicators.note: concealing means the letters lie within the words and is maybe

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue: perhaps there is sadness hidden in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Dismay is distress or sadness at bad news.

definitions.meaning: a list of cargo or passengers carried by a ship or plane

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means plain or open; as a noun it is a cargo list.

clue.text: Substitute's deceit swallowed by football official

indicators.note: swallowed by means the deceit word goes inside the official

parts.note: ref is short for referee
a lie is a deceit

explanation.surface: A sub's dishonesty is taken in by the referee.
explanation.definitionFit: A relief is someone who takes over from another, a substitute.

indicators.note: crashes suggests a smash-up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A driver who did not look crashes on the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Destined for somewhere means bound or heading there, en route.
